title: The Part Library page keeps upper and lower case in a typed part number
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location.
  • Use a new part number written in mixed capitals and small letters that no Part Library entry has.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Replace the Part Number with the mixed-case number, typing its capitals and small letters exactly.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Parts in the top bar.
  7. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  8. Type the mixed-case number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens.

Step 4:

  • The field shows the letters exactly as typed: small letters are not turned into capitals.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and the detail page's "Part number" reads the mixed-case number exactly as typed.

Step 6:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 7:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 8:

  • Part A is listed with the same mix of capitals and small letters.
